name: Cookie
source:
An egg-shaped robot invented by the Kuki Family and given to [url=https://vndb.org/c3508]Kazuko[/url] from [url=https://vndb.org/c8346]Hideo Kuki[/url] as a gift. 

Lives with the Kazama Family and can make popcorn, soda, and other foods and drinks appear from inside itself. Cookie now refers to [url=https://vndb.org/c3886]Shouichi[/url] as his master (Kazuko as his former master), but still serves all the members of the Kazama Family. Cookie tends to favor especially [url=https://vndb.org/c3509]Miyako[/url], which is noticed by [url=https://vndb.org/c3885]Yamato[/url]. This is because she diligently polishes him while he cleans their secret base. Despite being a robot, Cookie has emotions and can act accordingly to them. 

He has 108 transformations but only 4 of them are shown with number 1 being his main form to serve, his second being a combat military form that wields a sabre, and his third being a brain form which takes the the form of a small egg, and his fourth being of a beautiful teenage girl.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maji_de_Watashi_ni_Koishinasai!]Wikipedia[/url]]
